title: Megan Stalter's Midas touch, Zendaya's Prada crystals and other stunning red carpet looks at the 2026 Emmys

image.caption: Hacks' star Megan Stalter stunned the red carpet dressed as an Emmy statuette. (Amy Sussman/Getty Images)

blocks.text: Style

The 78th Emmy Awards, which recognize excellence in television, are taking place Monday evening at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Here are the best looks from the red carpet, which is actually peacock blue this year, a nod to the host network, NBC.
Top fashion moments from television's biggest night

The 78th Emmy Awards are underway at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, where stars of the small screen walked a red carpet that was actually blue this year, a nod to the 100th anniversary of the host network, NBC, and its stylized peacock logo.

Hosted by actor Mariska Hargitay, the event recognizes excellence in television and features a special musical tribute to Dolly Parton led by Reba McEntire, as well as an in memoriam performance of Bridge Over Troubled Water by Noah Kahan. The ceremony also celebrates the 30th anniversary of Buffy the Vampire Slayer and the 50th anniversary of Charlie’s Angels.

Some Emmys were already handed out at the Creative Arts Emmys earlier this month, while Monday night's ceremony brings an impressive list of stars to the stage. Dan Levy, John Mulaney, Awkwafina, Shailene Woodley, Alan Cumming, Florence Pugh and Annie Murphy are just a few of the confirmed presenters.
Here are the must-see looks from this year’s carpet.
Supriya Ganesh
(Amy Sussman/Getty Images)
Ganesh, The Pitt actor, wore a pale blue McQueen gown with ruffle details and a sheer underlayer with Irene Neuwirth jewelry.
Matty Matheson
The Canadian chef and co-star/executive producer of The Bear wore a tailored brown-and-black tuxedo with a classic white shirt.
Lisa Rinna
(Monica Schipper/Getty Images)
Former The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills star Rinna, who appears in Season 4 of Traitors, wore a sculptural, asymmetrical black gown by Lever Couture.
Grace Gummer
(Lisa O'Connor/AFP/Getty Images)
The Love Story actor, who walked the red carpet with husband, Mark Ronson, wore a black pleated column dress by Dior with a standout collar necklace.
Joy Sunday
Sunday, nominated for her work in DTF St. Louis, wore an off-white embellished gown by Dior with a train and thigh-high slit.
Noah Kahan
The singer-songwriter, who will be performing at tonight’s Emmys, wore a sharp black tuxedo by Bode with colourful lapel pins and a ribbon bow tie.
Colman Domingo
Nominated in two categories this year for his performances in The Four Seasons and Euphoria, Domingo wore a striking ensemble by Valentino featuring an orange jacket and pink belt.
Lukita Maxwell
The Shrinking star wore a custom champagne-gold taffeta dress by Louis Vuitton with white satin pumps.
Megan Stalter
The comedian and actor, nominated for Hacks, walked the carpet dressed like a golden Emmy Award statuette.
Cynthia Nixon
Nixon, star of And Just Like That… and The Gilded Age, wore a pleated runway look from Issey Miyake’s fall/winter 2026 collection.
Alan Cumming
Cumming, who won an Emmy for the third year in a row for his work hosting The Traitors, stood out in an embellished double-breasted suit with white shoes.
Zendaya
Nominated for her work in Euphoria, the actor sported a pixie cut and a stunning semi-sheer gown covered in crystals, custom-made by Prada.
Selena Gomez
The singer and Only Murders in the Building star paired a strapless gold Louis Vuitton gown with jewelry from Tiffany & Co.
Nicole Kidman

The actor, an executive producer on Margo’s Got Money Troubles, which is nominated for Outstanding Comedy Series, attended the Emmys in a white strapless dress by Chanel trimmed with 46 handmade flowers.
Florence Pugh
A presenter this evening, the actor wore a dreamy, floor-sweeping purple gown with a sheer tulle overlay by Vivienne Westwood.
Riz Ahmed
Nominated for his work in Bait, the actor wore an oversized blue-grey suit with a statement rolled cuff.
Emilia Clarke
The actor and Emmy presenter walked the carpet in a pale pink strapless gown by Prada with a dramatic cape.
Claire Danes
Danes, nominated for The Beast in Me, wore a sculptural silver dress by Giorgio Armani.
Sarah Pidgeon
Nominated for Love Story, Pidgeon wore a drapey, pale purple custom Chanel gown with an embellished neckline.
Dan Levy
The Canadian actor wore a custom Celine tuxedo on the carpet this evening. Levy will be honouring his Schitt’s Creek co-star, the late Catherine O’Hara, during the broadcast.
ABOUT THE AUTHOR
Truc Nguyen is a Toronto-based writer, editor and stylist. Follow her at @trucnguyen.
